notes:
New: canvas render engine (experimental). The in-game map can now be placed as a real Foundry Tile — it shows in the Placeables list, sorts and z-orders under tokens, and works cross-browser.

It composites the token-centred scene, frame plates, marker and the per-theme treatment (parchment and sci-fi) to match the window and overlay look, with portrait/landscape rotation. Exposed via the Tiles-toolbar buttons and the module API.

Also in this release

  • The Show on in-game map checkbox in the Tile configuration appears only on the Appearance tab, instead of on every tab (v13+ tabbed TileConfig).
  • Fixed a Foundry v14 Scene#background deprecation warning.
  • Now requires Scorpious187's Module Library, installed automatically as a dependency, which hosts the family update notifier.
